name: Terang Bangsa Christian School Semarang
address: Jl. Arteri Utara, Komplek Grand Marina A3, Tawangsari, Semarang Barat, Kota Semarang

notes.id: Uang pangkal normal Rp10.000.000; promo gelombang 2 diskon 40% menjadi Rp6.000.000. Halaman tidak menyebut tahun ajaran.
notes.en: Normal entry fee Rp10,000,000; wave 2 promotion 40% off to Rp6,000,000. The page does not state the academic year.

source.title: SMA Kristen Terang Bangsa — Biaya & Alur Pendaftaran (situs resmi)

steps.id: Beli formulir di Admission gedung A lt. 1 (Rp25.000), atau isi formulir online lalu admin menghubungi sesuai antrean.
steps.en: Buy the form at Admissions, building A floor 1 (Rp25,000), or fill in the online form and wait for the admin to contact you.

steps.id: Tanya jawab informasi sekolah di Admission.
steps.en: Q&A about the school at Admissions.

steps.id: Serahkan formulir, bukti transfer, dan kelengkapan pendaftaran ke TU jenjang.
steps.en: Hand the form, transfer receipt and documents to the level's administration office.

steps.id: Pengukuran seragam, lalu siswa siap mengikuti pembelajaran.
steps.en: Uniform fitting, then the student is ready to start.

source.title: SMA Kristen Terang Bangsa — Biaya & Alur Pendaftaran (situs resmi)
